title: Student DBMS using C/C++
description: A C-based project implementing core data structures for managing student records efficiently using flat text files.
longDescription: The Student Database Management System is a console-based project built in C that manages student data such as names, roll numbers, and grades using file handling and structured data operations. It performs key CRUD operations—add, search, update, delete—without relying on any external database. The project demonstrates strong understanding of data structures, file I/O, and memory management in C programming.
features: Implements CRUD operations for student records
Uses flat text files for persistent storage
Efficient record management using structured data
Demonstrates C file handling and memory management
Simple CLI interface for user interaction

title: Student Ranking System using C/C++
description: A C-based program that processes and ranks students using sorting algorithms and structured data management.
longDescription: The Student Ranking System is a console-based C project that reads, stores, and processes student data to generate merit-based rankings. It utilizes data structures such as arrays and structures, combined with sorting algorithms like Bubble Sort or Quick Sort, to efficiently compute and display student ranks. The project demonstrates practical application of algorithmic logic, structured programming, and performance optimization in C.
features: Processes student records for ranking and performance analysis
Implements sorting algorithms for merit-based ranking
Uses structured data for efficient storage and retrieval
Provides simple command-line interface for operations
Demonstrates algorithmic logic and data structure proficiency
